theme: Light theme default with warm restrained editorial palette (calm stone neutrals, terracotta/clay accent, deep slate typography)

typography.pairing_archetype: The Old Money Editorial Tech: Warm literary serif for conversational travel sketches + clean geometric DM Sans for chat bubbles and structured planning state

entry_surfaces./: conversation-first travel workbench: top minimal branded nav + persistent state switcher, left/center expansive chat canvas with rich response artifacts, right collapsible Current Plan inspector (mobile: bottom drawer/tabs)

visual_enhancers.paper_texture: Subtle warm stone tint with 1px border strokes (#E7E2D8) and 0.5px inner hairline dividers

prototype_states.title: 1. New Trip (Conversational Start)
prototype_states.description: Minimal, welcoming conversational start. Freeform travel query with lightweight origin/dates/travelers chips.
prototype_states.default_prompt: We have about 8 days in December from Bangalore. Couple plus a 10-year-old. Thinking Hong Kong and Macau but open.

prototype_states.title: 2. First Trip Sketch
prototype_states.description: Selective rich imagery, suggested destination order (HK 5 nights -> Macau 3 nights), trade-offs (peak crowd, ferry vs bridge), feasibility alerts, and 3 open decisions.

prototype_states.title: 3. Mature Solo Trip
prototype_states.description: Ongoing conversational workspace with canonical collapsible Current Plan side-by-side: stays booked/unbooked, route milestones, open decisions, and live itinerary graph.

prototype_states.title: 4. Material Plan Change
prototype_states.description: User says 'Actually, let's do Macau first.' JugIQ presents an explicit side-by-side Before/After comparison (HK->Macau vs Macau->HK), sequence logistics impact, Apply button, and contextual Undo.

prototype_states.title: 5. Group Trip Room
prototype_states.description: Multiplayer family chat (Priya, Arjun, Rohan). AI responds only on @JugIQ or 'Revise Trip'. Shows synthesis of conflicting dates/activities while retaining unresolved items as Open Decisions.

prototype_states.title: 6. Booking Comparison (Neutral Ranking)
prototype_states.description: Cross-provider comparison for Peak Tram + Sky Terrace & Cotai Ferry. Strict traveller-value ranking (verified price, cancellation, instant pass), clear checked timestamp, and transparent neutrality disclosure.

Macau heritage colonial arches and cobblestone

motion.chat_message_entrance: opacity 0 to 1, y 8px to 0px, duration 0.25s ease-out
motion.plan_revision_shimmer: subtle pulse highlight on changed route nodes for 1.2s
motion.state_switch_transition: fade and slight slide across views
motion.hover_elements: transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA (all text >= 4.5:1 contrast against respective surface)
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, state-switchers, decisions, compare items have kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='apply-change-button', data-testid='open-decisions-badge', data-testid='state-switcher-group-room')
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab and enter/space support for decision pills, plan toggles, drawer controls and chat inputs
accessibility.aria_roles: aria-live='polite' for conversational streaming, aria-expanded for Current Plan drawer

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain conversation-first feel: chat is the dominant workspace; Current Plan is a structured companion, never a traditional bureaucratic OTA itinerary.
Implement the 6 distinct clickable prototype states seamlessly with both guided 'Next Step' button and a persistent top State Switcher banner.

Keep interactive controls realistic: typing custom queries triggers contextual simulated responses; quick chips inject starter text; 'Actually Macau first' triggers route diff; 'Revise Trip' runs consensus synthesis; 'Compare booking' opens un-biased multi-provider modal.

Include the crucial neutrality disclosure banner in the Booking Comparison modal: 'JugIQ ranks options strictly on verified traveller value (price, cancellation, convenience). Partner commissions never influence ranking.'
Ensure full responsiveness: on mobile (< 1024px), Current Plan switches from side-panel to sticky bottom sheet/toggle drawer with badge counter.

Do NOT add fake auth forms, payment checkouts, or technical AI jargon ('LLM temperature', 'tokens', 'Compute Wallet'). Keep vocabulary focused on: Current Plan, Open Decisions, Revise Trip, Invite, Compare, Apply changes, Undo.
